objective: Correct the dormant ROM presence reducer so local and remote warp sequences remain independent while preserving strict partition, ordering, and interaction invariants.
closed_decisions: Warp sequences are player-local monotonic nonzero counters, not a shared partition identifier.
The local reducer context remains session epoch, region, map group, map number, and local warp sequence; changing any local context field clears the active remote.
Initial remote admission requires the same region and map only and accepts any nonzero remote warp sequence.
An active remote is keyed by opaque handle and its own stored warp sequence inside the current local context; an ordinary update or duplicate spawn cannot change that remote warp sequence.
Interaction observes and encodes the active target's remote warp sequence and never compares it with the local player's warp sequence.
All existing strict decoding, RFC 1982 server ordering, exact-session, no-eviction, no-implicit-spawn, and rejection-without-mutation invariants remain unchanged.
This prerequisite does not activate the live bridge, change protocol versions, render ObjectEvents, or add runtime callbacks.
forbidden_changes: Do not edit headers, Rust crates, net_bridge, Lua, ObjectEvent/input code, build files, generated files, documentation, or orchestration state.

Do not compare a remote warp sequence to the local warp sequence, silently adopt a changed remote warp on update or duplicate spawn, or weaken region/map/session/handle/sequence/elevation/adjacency checks.
Do not stage, commit, branch, fetch, pull, push, contact remotes, create or remove worktrees, or revert another worker's edits.

acceptance_criteria.description: A same-region and same-map spawn with local warp 7 and remote warp 41 is accepted and stores remote warp 41.
Interaction with the valid adjacent remote encodes observed warp 41 rather than local warp 7 while retaining all current context, elevation, facing, and adjacency checks.
A newer update retaining remote warp 41 succeeds; an otherwise valid update or duplicate spawn carrying warp 42 is rejected without mutating reducer state.
Synchronizing local warp 7 to 8 clears the remote even on the same map, while region and map mismatches remain rejected.
Focused Cloud Coop presence tests and the natural full ROM checks pass with the diff confined to the two owned files.

focused: rtk wsl -d Ubuntu-24.04 --cd <worker-worktree> -- make check TESTS="Cloud Coop presence"

return_when: Every acceptance criterion is resolved and all verification outcomes are recorded.
The correction cannot be made within the two owned files without changing a closed decision.
A concrete toolchain or isolated-worktree failure prevents progress within the execution budget.
